status: Exploratory common-procedure kinetic comparison; processing sensitivity is reported.

bootstrap.multiplier_block: ceil(N^(1/3)); random offset; signs +/-1; deterministic substrate-index seed

fitting: Same original rate scale and full propagated overlap covariance for all candidates; K in [1e-4,1e4]; nonnegative amplitudes; S2 explicitly embedded in S5 at k_side=0; centered GLS R2 and working-Gaussian AICc.
secondary: Fit integrated S2/S3/S5 directly to the identical original-point range used by the primary SG extraction, at its fixed tail10 background; include iid and stationary AR1 errors and report complete residual/optimizer diagnostics.
interpretation_rules: Retain all fitted results, negative rate estimates and parameter-boundary diagnostics.
Report background and differentiation-window sensitivity alongside the primary comparison.
Interpret AICc differences conditional on the stated preprocessing and covariance model.
Include the small-K/background-offset diagnostic and the pure-first-order control.
